#  About Us 
**CEL-MER** , was established as a 4-stand hot rolling mill by our current chairman, Mechanical Engineer Mr. Gazi YILMAZ in 1986 in Bayrampasa, Istanbul. The establishing philosophy and the mission was focusing to the value-added / un-common business; so it started with high-alloyed steel bar production. 
Today, on a 95.000 m² open, 30.000 m² closed area in Cayirova, Kocaeli; CEL-MER continues its production with 
  * A modern semi-continuous hot rolling mill,
  * Peeling,
  * Grinding,
  * Cold Drawing and
  * Heat treatment units.


Our company is one of the leading companies in the quality and bright steel production. By the variety of production possibilities and flexibility; it is unique in its field in the country. 
Current production range covers special profiles, flat, square, hexagonal, octagonal, triangle and round sections; and product diversity serves to a wide chemical analysis range. Beside steel products; projects with various super alloys, titanium alloys, cobalt alloys etc are being realized. Continuous improvement, digitalization, process and product optimization are being carried out as a part of routine processes to provide high quality products with lower prices. With its client oriented, flexible production strategy; CEL-MER meets raw material requirements of various sectors by its well-established and skilled staff.
